blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent post-training approaches have shown that self-supervised speech encoders can be adapted to learn a single utterance-level speech attribute through knowledge distillation. In this work, we investigate whether a single speech encoder can simultaneously preserve multiple complementary utterance-level speech representations. We propose a multi-attribute multi-teacher distillation framework that learns semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations from four frozen teacher models using a shared SSL backbone and attribute-specific branches. Experiments on multilingual semantic retrieval, speaker verification, language identification, and speech emotion recognition show that the proposed model achieves performance close to dedicated single-task students while requiring only a single shared encoder. Furthermore, the learned layer aggregation strategies reveal that different speech attributes naturally emerge at different depths of the SSL encoder, providing new insights into the organization of speech representations.
blocks.zh: 最近的后培训方法表明,自我监督的语音编码器可以通过知识分解来被改造来学习单一的语音层次的语音属性. 在这项工作中,我们调查单一的语音编码器是否能够同时保留多个互补的语音层次的语音表述. 我们提出一个多属性的多教师提炼框架,利用共享的SSL主干和属性特定分支,从四个被冻结的教师模型中学习语义,演讲者,语言和情感表达. 关于多语种语义检索,演讲者验证,语言识别,和语音情感识别的实验表明,所拟议的模型实现了接近专注的单任务学生的性能,同时只需要一个单一的共享编码器. 此外,学习的分层汇总战略表明,不同的语音属性自然出现在SSL编码器的不同深度上,为语音表述的组织提供了新的见解.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Speech conveys multiple complementary types of information beyond its linguistic content. In addition to the lexical message, an utterance carries information about the speaker identity, the spoken language, emotional state, speaking style, and other paralinguistic characteristics. These complementary attributes are essential for a broad range of applications including multilingual speech retrieval, speaker verification, language identification, conversational agents, speech analytics, and affective computing. Nevertheless, they are generally modeled independently, leading to multiple task-specific encoders that duplicate computation and fail to exploit the common structure underlying speech.
blocks.zh: 语音传递语言内容以外的多种互补类型信息. 除了词汇信息外,一个语音还包含有关演说者身份,口语,情感状态,说话风格等语言特征的信息. 这些互补属性对于多种语言语音检索,语音验证,语言识别,对话代理,语音分析,以及情感计算等广泛的应用至关重要. 尽管如此,它们一般都是独立建模的,导致多个任务特定编码器重复计算,无法利用共同的结构基础语音.

blocks.en: Recent advances in self-supervised learning (SSL) have profoundly changed speech representation learning. Foundation models such as wav2vec 2.0 [ 1 ] , HuBERT [ 2 ] , WavLM [ 3 ] , and w2v-BERT [ 4 ] are trained on thousands of hours of unlabeled speech and produce generic contextual representations that achieve remarkable performance across many downstream tasks. While these models naturally produce frame-level representations, many applications require utterance-level embeddings that summarize global properties of an entire speech segment. Rather than redesigning SSL pre-training objectives, several recent works have demonstrated that these foundation models can be effectively adapted through post-training , transferring knowledge from pretrained expert models into a shared speech encoder.
blocks.zh: 近期在自我监督学习(SSL)方面的进步深刻改变了语音表现学习. Wav2vec 2.0 [1], HuBERT [2], WavLM [3], W2v-BERT [4] 等基础模型在几千小时无标签的演讲上接受了培训,并产生了通用的上下文表述,在很多下游任务上取得了显著的成绩. 虽然这些模型自然会产生帧级的表示,但许多应用需要表达级的嵌入,以总结整个语音部分的全球属性. 近期的一些著作不是重新设计SSL培训前目标,而是表明这些基础模型可以通过培训后有效调整,将知识从经过培训的专家模型转移到共用的语音编码器。

blocks.en: A particularly successful direction consists in learning semantic speech embeddings through teacher-student knowledge distillation. Frameworks such as SAMU-XLSR [ 5 ] , SONAR [ 6 , 7 ] , and SENSE [ 8 ] align speech representations with multilingual sentence embedding spaces, enabling multilingual and multimodal retrieval. More recently, multi-teacher post-training has been proposed to jointly learn semantic and speaker representations within a single SSL speech encoder [ 9 ] . These results demonstrate that multiple utterance-level attributes can coexist in a unified representation while preserving competitive performance on both semantic retrieval and speaker verification.
blocks.zh: 一个特别成功的方向是通过师生知识蒸馏来学习语义语音嵌入. SAMU-XLSR [5], SONAR [6, 7], SENSE [8] 等框架使语音表述与多语种句子嵌入空间相一致,能够进行多语种和多模式检索。 最近,有人提议进行多教师后培训,在一个单一的SSL语音编码器内共同学习语义和演讲者表述[9]. 这些结果表明,多种语音层面的属性可以在统一代表制中共存,同时在语义检索和扬声器验证上保持竞争性表现.

blocks.en: However, extending this paradigm beyond two attributes remains an open challenge. Semantic content, speaker identity, language identity, and emotion emerge at different abstraction levels within SSL speech encoders and rely on heterogeneous supervision signals originating from different datasets and teacher models. Simply adding new objectives may lead to conflicting optimization dynamics and representation interference. Whether a single post-trained SSL encoder can simultaneously preserve these complementary dimensions of speech therefore remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 然而,将这一范式扩大到两个属性之外仍然是一个公开的挑战。 语义内容,扬声器身份,语言身份,和情感在SSL语音编码器的不同抽象层次上出现,并依赖于来自不同数据集和师范模型的不同监督信号. 仅仅增加新的目标就可能导致相互矛盾的优化动态和代表性干扰。 因此,单一的经过培训的SSL编码器能否同时保留这些互补的语音维度,基本上仍未加以探讨。

blocks.en: In this paper, we address this challenge by proposing a holistic multi-teacher post-training framework that learns four complementary utterance-level representations from a single shared SSL speech encoder. The proposed framework distills semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations from four specialized frozen teachers while introducing two key mechanisms to facilitate joint optimization. First, each attribute learns its own layer aggregation strategy, allowing different branches to exploit the encoder layers that are most informative for their target representation. Second, we propose a gain-based loss weighting strategy derived from mono-task learning dynamics to balance heterogeneous teachers exhibiting different convergence behaviors.
blocks.zh: 在这份文件中,我们通过提出一个全面的多教师培训后框架来应对这一挑战,该框架从一个共享的SSL语音编码器中学习四个互补的语音层面的表述。 拟议框架提炼了四个专业冷冻教师的语义、演讲者、语言和情感表述,同时引入了两个关键机制,以促进联合优化。 首先,每个属性学习自己的层聚合策略,允许不同的分支利用编码层,这些编码层对于它们的目标表示性最有信息性. 第二,我们提出一种基于增益的损失加权策略,从单一任务学习动态中衍生出来,以平衡表现出不同趋同行为的多样化教师。

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed framework on four downstream tasks covering all distilled attributes: multilingual semantic retrieval, speaker verification, language identification, and speech emotion recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于四项下游任务的拟议框架,涵盖所有提炼出来的属性:多语语种语义检索、语音验证、语言识别和语音情感识别。

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are fourfold: • We significantly extend recent multi-teacher post-training approaches by jointly learning four complementary utterance-level speech attributes instead of two. • We propose a holistic post-training framework for SSL speech encoders combining attribute-specific layer aggregation with a gain-based loss weighting strategy. • We demonstrate that a single shared encoder preserves semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations across four independent downstream evaluation tasks. • We provide an analysis of layer utilization showing how different speech attributes emerge at different depths of a shared SSL speech encoder.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献有四个方面: 我们通过共同学习四个互补的语音层面特征而不是两个,大大扩展了最近多教师培训后方法。 我们提议为SSL语音编码器建立一个全面的培训后框架,将特定属性层汇总与基于增益的损失加权策略结合起来。 我们证明,一个单一的共同编码器保留了四个独立下游评价任务的语义、演说、语言和情感表述。 我们提供了对层利用的分析,显示在共享的SSL语音编码器的不同深度中如何出现不同的语音属性.

blocks.en: We significantly extend recent multi-teacher post-training approaches by jointly learning four complementary utterance-level speech attributes instead of two.
blocks.zh: 我们通过共同学习四个互补的语音层面的特征而不是两个,大大扩展了最近多教师培训后方法。

blocks.en: We propose a holistic post-training framework for SSL speech encoders combining attribute-specific layer aggregation with a gain-based loss weighting strategy.
blocks.zh: 我们提议为SSL语音编码器建立一个整体培训后框架,结合属性特定层的汇总和基于增益的损失加权策略.

blocks.en: We demonstrate that a single shared encoder preserves semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations across four independent downstream evaluation tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们证明,一个共享编码器保留了四个独立下游评估任务的语义、演说者、语言和情感表述。

blocks.en: We provide an analysis of layer utilization showing how different speech attributes emerge at different depths of a shared SSL speech encoder.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了对层利用的分析,显示在共享的SSL语音编码器的不同深度中如何出现不同的语音属性.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Post-training of speech foundation models
blocks.zh: II-A 语音基础模型培训后

blocks.en:
Recent work has increasingly viewed post-training as a distinct stage in the lifecycle of speech foundation models, complementing large-scale self-supervised pre-training. Rather than modifying the expensive pre-training process, post-training adapts a generic speech encoder to downstream objectives through techniques including domain adaptation, instruction tuning, continual learning, and knowledge distillation [ 10 , 11 ] .
Existing post-training approaches can be broadly categorized into four directions: adaptation, alignment, reasoning, and efficiency [ 12 ] . Such post-training approaches have also explored efficiency through model compression and knowledge distillation [ 13 ] .
In this work, rather than compressing a single expert, we consolidate the knowledge of multiple specialized teacher models into a single shared speech encoder, reducing the number of deployed encoders while preserving multiple speech attributes.
The resulting model replaces multiple task-specific encoders with a single backbone capable of producing semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作越来越把培训后视为语音基础模型生命周期中的一个独特阶段,是对大规模自我监督的前期培训的补充。 培训后不修改昂贵的培训前程序,而是通过包括域调整、教学调整、持续学习和知识蒸馏在内的技术,使通用语音编码器适应下游的目标[10、11]。
现有的培训后办法可大致分为四个方向:适应、调整、推理和效率[12]。 这种培训后办法还通过模型压缩和知识蒸馏探索效率[13].
在这部作品中,我们不是压缩单个专家,而是将多个专业教师模型的知识整合为一个共享的语音编码器,减少部署的编码器数量,同时保留多个语音属性.
由此形成的模型用一个能够产生语义,扬声器,语言,和情感表现的单一主干取代多个任务特定编码器.

blocks.en: II-B Learning utterance-level speech representations
blocks.zh: II-B 学习性演讲

blocks.en:
While self-supervised speech encoders naturally produce contextual frame-level representations, many downstream applications require compact utterance-level embeddings that summarize an entire speech segment.
Early efforts mainly focused on learning a single attribute. Semantic speech representations have received particular attention through teacher-student distillation, where speech utterances are aligned with multilingual sentence embedding spaces.
Representative examples include SAMU-XLSR [ 5 ] , SONAR [ 6 , 7 ] , and SENSE [ 8 ] , which produce language-agnostic utterance embeddings suitable for multilingual speech-speech and speech-text retrieval.
These approaches demonstrate that semantic information can be effectively transferred from powerful text encoders to speech foundation models while preserving cross-lingual generalization.
blocks.zh:
虽然自我监督的语音编码器自然会产生上下文帧层的表示,但许多下游应用需要紧凑的语音层嵌入,总结了整个语音部分.
早期的努力主要集中于学习一个单一的属性. 通过教师-学生的蒸馏,语义表达得到了特别关注,其中语义表达与多语种句子嵌入空间一致.
具有代表性的例子包括:SAMU-XLSR[5]、SONAR[6]、7]和SENSE[8],它们产生适合多语种语音和语音文本检索的语言不可知语句。
这些方法表明语义信息可以从强大的文本编码器有效转移到语音基础模型,同时保留跨语言的泛化.

blocks.en:
Beyond semantics, several studies have investigated utterance-level representations dedicated to specific paralinguistic attributes. Speaker verification systems typically rely on speaker embeddings extracted from models such as ECAPA-TDNN [ 14 ] , while language identification has similarly benefited from utterance-level embeddings trained on multilingual corpora such as VoxLingua107 [ 15 ] .
More recently, speech emotion representation learning has attracted increasing attention, with models such as emotion2vec [ 16 ] demonstrating that large-scale self-supervised pre-training can produce transferable emotion embeddings across a wide range of downstream emotion recognition tasks.
blocks.zh:
除了语义学之外,一些研究还调查了专门用于特定语言学属性的语音层次表述. 发言人核查系统通常依靠从ECAPA-TDNN[14]等模型中提取的演讲者嵌入,而语言识别同样从VoxLingua107[15]等多语种公司培训的语音层面嵌入也受益匪浅.
最近,语音情感表现学习引起了越来越多的关注,情感2vec[16]等模型显示,大规模自我监督的预训可以产生跨越广泛下游情感识别任务的可转移情感嵌入.

blocks.en:
Although these representations target different speech properties, they share a common characteristic: each embedding space is optimized independently for a single attribute.
As a consequence, practical systems typically require several specialized encoders operating in parallel, increasing memory usage, computational cost, and deployment complexity.
Only recently have a few studies begun to investigate whether multiple utterance-level representations can be jointly learned from a shared speech encoder through multi-teacher distillation [ 9 ] .
These first results suggest that multiple speech attributes can coexist within a common SSL encoder, opening new perspectives for unified utterance-level representation learning.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些表达式针对不同的语音属性,但它们有一个共同的特征:每个嵌入空间都为单个属性独立优化.
因此,实用系统通常需要几个平行运行的专门编码器,增加内存使用、计算成本和部署的复杂性。
最近才开始进行一些研究,研究能否通过多教师蒸馏[9]从一个共同的语音编码器中共同学习多种语音层面的表述.
这些最初的结果表明,多种语音属性可以在一个共同的SSL编码器内共存,为统一语音层次的代表学习开辟了新的视角.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en:
Figure 1 illustrates the proposed framework. A shared SSL speech encoder processes the input utterance and produces contextual hidden representations at all encoder layers.
Four attribute-specific branches, corresponding to semantic content, speaker identity, language identity and emotion, independently aggregate these hidden representations through learnable layer interpolation, followed by attention pooling and a projection layer. Each branch is supervised by a frozen teacher model through cosine embedding distillation.
The entire architecture is trained end-to-end while sharing a single speech encoder across all attributes.
blocks.zh:
图1说明了拟议框架。 一个共享的SSL语音编码器处理输入语句,并在所有编码器层产生上下文隐藏的表示.
4个属性特定分支,对应语义内容,演说者身份,语言身份和情感,通过可学习的层内插独立地将这些隐含的表示进行汇总,之后是注意力集合和一个投影层. 每个分支都由冷冻的教师模型通过余弦嵌入蒸馏来监督.
整个架构都是经过训练的端到端,同时在所有属性上共享一个单一的语音编码器.

blocks.en: III-A Shared encoder with attribute-specific branches
blocks.zh: III-A 具有属性特定分支的共享编码器

The student encoder is initialized from a pretrained speech foundation model.
Given an input utterance x i x_{i} , the encoder produces a sequence of hidden representations at different layers: 𝐇 i ( ℓ ) ∈ ℝ T i × D , \mathbf{H}_{i}^{(\ell)}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{i}\times D}, where T i T_{i} is the number of frames, D D is the dimension of hidden representations, and ℓ ∈ { 1 , … , L } \ell\in\{1,\ldots,L\} denotes the encoder layer.
Instead of using a fixed hidden layer for all attributes, we allow each attribute-specific branch to learn which encoder layers are most useful for its corresponding teacher.

blocks.en: III-B Multi-teacher distillation objective
blocks.zh: 三-B 多教师蒸馏目标

blocks.en: For each attribute a a , the student branch is trained to maximize the cosine similarity with the corresponding teacher representation. The attribute-specific loss is defined as: ℒ i a = 1 − cos ⁡ ( 𝐳 i , a , 𝐲 i a ) . \mathcal{L}_{i}^{a}=1-\cos(\mathbf{z}_{i,a},\mathbf{y}_{i}^{a}).
blocks.zh: 对于每个属性 a ,学生分支接受培训,以最大限度地实现与相应教师代表的余弦相似. 属性特定损失的定义为:L i a = 1 − cos → (z i, a, y i a ). \ mathcal{L}_{i}^{a}=1-\cos(\mathbf{z}_{i,a},\mathbf{y}_{i}^{a}).

blocks.en:
A central difficulty in holistic multi-teacher distillation is that the different teachers have heterogeneous embedding dimensions, training dynamics, and levels of difficulty.
Uniform loss weighting may therefore over-emphasize attributes that are easier to optimize or whose losses have larger magnitudes.
blocks.zh:
整体多教师提炼的一个中心困难是,不同的教师具有不同的嵌入维度、培训动态和难度。
因此,统一损失加权可能过分强调较易优化或损失规模较大的属性。

blocks.en:
Mono-task learning provides an estimate of how much useful information can be transferred from each teacher into the student architecture.
Attributes exhibiting larger learning gains tend to correspond to teachers that are easier for the student to approximate.
blocks.zh:
单任务学习提供了从每个老师可以将多少有用的信息转移到学生建筑的估计.
学习成绩较大的属性往往与教师相对应,而教师对学生来说比较容易。

blocks.en: Assigning them larger weights encourages the Multi-Attribute optimization to focus on supervision signals that are better aligned with the student capacity, while avoiding over-emphasizing attributes that are intrinsically difficult or noisy.
blocks.zh: 给他们分配更大的权重,鼓励多属性优化,将注意力集中在更符合学生能力的监督信号上,同时避免过度强调本质上困难或吵闹的属性.

blocks.en:
We introduce a gain-based weighting strategy derived from mono-task learning dynamics.
For each attribute a a , we first train a mono-task student using the same architecture but retaining only branch a a .
Let ℒ a mono ​ ( e ) \mathcal{L}_{a}^{\mathrm{mono}}(e) denote the normalized validation loss of this mono-task model at epoch e e .
The learning gain for attribute a a is defined as: g a = ℒ a mono ​ ( 1 ) − min e ⁡ ℒ a mono ​ ( e ) . g_{a}=\mathcal{L}_{a}^{\mathrm{mono}}(1)-\min_{e}\mathcal{L}_{a}^{\mathrm{mono}}(e).
blocks.zh:
我们采用了一种从单一任务学习动态中衍生出来的基于增益的加权策略.
对于每个属性 一个,我们首先训练 一个单任务学生 使用相同的架构 但只保留分支 a。
让 L 单曲 (e)\ mathcal{L}_{a}^{\a}^{\mathrm{mono}}(e) 表示在 e 时此单曲任务模式的正常验证损失 。

blocks.en: The final Multi-Attribute weight is obtained by normalizing the gains across attributes: λ a = g a ∑ b ∈ 𝒜 g b . \lambda_{a}=\frac{g_{a}}{\sum_{b\in\mathcal{A}}g_{b}}.
blocks.zh: 最终的多属性权重是通过将各种属性的增益正常化获得的: λ a = g a ∑ b ∈ A g b . \lambda_{a}=\frac{g_{a}}{\sum_{b\in\mathcal{A}}g_{b}}].

blocks.en:
This strategy assigns larger weights to attributes for which the student shows stronger learning progress in the corresponding mono-task setting, while reducing the contribution of attributes that rapidly saturate or provide weaker training gains.
Unlike dynamic weighting strategies such as uncertainty weighting or GradNorm [ 18 ] , the proposed weights are estimated once from mono-task learning dynamics and remain fixed during multi-teacher training, avoiding additional optimization variables and training instability.
blocks.zh:
这一策略为学生在相应的单任务设定中表现出较强学习进展的属性分配了更大的权重,同时减少了快速饱和或提供较弱培训收益的属性的贡献.
与不确定性权重或GradNorm[18]等动态权重策略不同,拟议权重从单任务学习动态中估算一次,在多师资培训期间保持不变,避免了额外的优化变量和培训不稳定.

blocks.en: Although four attributes are considered in this work, the proposed framework is generic. Adding a new utterance-level attribute only requires a frozen teacher model and an additional attribute-specific branch, without modifying the shared speech encoder or the optimization procedure.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项工作考虑了四个属性,但拟议框架是通用的。 添加一个新的语音级别属性只需要一个冻结的老师模型和一个额外的属性特定分支,而不修改共享的语音编码器或优化程序.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: In order to evaluate the relevance of our proposition, we benchmark it on different tasks related to the targeted sentence-level attributes.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们建议的相关性,我们把它作为基准,用于与目标句子层面属性有关的不同任务。

blocks.en: IV-A Teacher supervision
blocks.zh: 教师监督

blocks.en:
We target four utterance-level attributes in our multi-teacher student learning framework: semantics, speaker, language, and emotion continuous representations.
For each attribute, we used a specialized teacher: the BGE-M3 text encoder (when transcription is available) or the SENSE speech encoder for semantics (BGE-M3 and SENSE share the same semantic continuous space), an ECAPA-TDNN speaker embeddings trained on VoxCeleb for speaker attribute, an ECAPA-TDNN language embedding model trained on VoxLingua107, and emotion2vec-base [ 16 ] as a teacher for emotion attribute.
All teacher models remain frozen throughout training.
blocks.zh:
在我们的多教师学生学习框架内,我们的目标是四个语言层面的属性:语义学、演说、语言和情感连续表达。
对于每个属性,我们使用了一个专业的老师:BGE-M3文本编码器(在有转录时)或SENSE语义的语音编码器(BGE-M3和SENSE共用相同的语义连续空间),一个ECAPA-TDNN演讲者嵌入VoxCeleb为演讲者属性而训练的演讲者,一个ECAPA-TDNN语言嵌入模型在VoxLingua107上训练的,以及情感2vec-base [16]作为情感属性的老师.
所有教师模式在整个培训期间都僵持不下。

blocks.en: IV-B Datasets
blocks.zh: 四-B 数据集

blocks.en:
The training data of our sentence-level multiple attribute speech encoder combines Common Voice 19 [ 19 ] and a collection of dataset annotated with emotion labels in different languages.
This list of emotion datasets used in our collection is presented in Table I .
blocks.zh:
我们的句子级多属性语音编码器的训练数据结合了共同语音19[19],以及用不同语言附加情感标签的数据集集.
我们收集的情感数据集列表见表一。

blocks.en:
From Common Voice 19, we use the 83 languages supported by BGE-M3.
Common Voice is mainly used for semantic, speaker, and language supervision, while the emotion collection provides affective speech data for emotion supervision and additional non-transcribed speech.
For the emotion collection, each corpus is split independently into 80% training, 10% development, and 10% test data.
After preprocessing, Common Voice provides 8,205.92 hours of speech and the emotion corpora provide 92.59 hours for training.
This results a total of 8,298.51 hours of training data. The emotion collection contains 31 speech emotion recognition datasets covering multiple languages, recording conditions, and emotion taxonomies.
Table I reports the language, number of emotion classes, and duration of each
emotion dataset.
blocks.zh:
从共同之声19,我们使用由BGE-M3支持的83种语言.
Common Voice主要用于语义学,扬声器,语言监督,而情感集则提供情感监督的感性语音数据和额外的非语义语音.
就情感收集而言,每个单元独立分为80%的培训、10%的发展和10%的测试数据。
在预处理后,Common Voice提供8,205.92小时的语音,情感公司提供92.59小时的训练.
培训数据共达8 298.51小时。 情感集包含31个语音情感识别数据集,涵盖多种语言,记录条件,以及情感分类.

blocks.en: IV-C Sampling strategy
blocks.zh: IV-C 抽样战略

blocks.en:
In order to balance the data sources across tasks and languages, we applied a resampling strategy similar to those proposed in [ 5 ] and [ 8 ] , which were used to train the SAMU-XLSR and SENSE models, respectively.
This strategy computes a sampling weight for each sample.
These weights are then used by the sampler to randomly select samples when constructing each training batch.
blocks.zh:
为了平衡不同任务和语言的数据来源,我们采用了类似于[5]和[8]中提议的再取样战略,分别用于培训SAMU-XLSR和SENSE模型。
本策略计算每个样本的采样权重.
这些权重随后被采样者用于在构建每批训练时随机选择样品.

blocks.en: IV-D Implementation and training details
blocks.zh: 四-D 执行和培训细节

blocks.en:
The shared speech encoder is initialized from w2v-BERT 2.0.
We implement the multi-teacher model in SpeechBrain, based on the open-source SENSE implementation.
All teacher embeddings are pre-computed before training
in order to reduce the training cost.
We fine-tune the shared w2v-BERT 2.0 encoder with Adam using a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
The task-specific modules are optimized separately
with Adadelta using an initial learning rate of 1.5.
Training is performed with a batch size of 14 for both training and validation.
The model is trained for 17,613 iterations using 32 H100 GPUs.
blocks.zh:
共享语音编码器从w2v-BERT2.0初始化.
我们在SpeechBrain实施基于开放源代码SENSE的多教师模式。
所有教师的嵌入在培训前都要预先计算
为了降低培训费用。
我们用10 - 5 10 - 5的学习率, 微调共享的w2v - BERT 2.0编码器。
任务特定模块分别优化
Adadelta的初始学习率为1.5。
培训的批量规模为14,用于培训和鉴定。
该型号使用32台H100GPU进行17,613次迭代训练.

blocks.en: IV-E Tasks
blocks.zh: 四-E 任务

blocks.en:
To evaluate the quality of the semantic representation learned by our approach, we assess the model on multilingual speech retrieval.
We evaluate the learned speaker
representations on a speaker verification benchmark, and the language branch through a language identification experiment based on a classifier trained on the extracted embeddings.
Last, we evaluate the emotion branch on speech emotion
recognition datasets using dataset-specific classifiers.
blocks.zh:
为了评价我们的方法所学到的语义表述的质量,我们评估了多语种语音检索模式。
我们评价这位博学的演讲者
在演讲者验证基准上表达,语言分支通过基于对提取嵌入物进行分类培训的语言识别实验.
最后,我们评价情绪分支 在语音情感
使用数据集特定分类器的识别数据集.

blocks.en:
For each attribute, we compare three types of representations: the
corresponding frozen teacher model, a single-task student model trained
only for the considered attribute, and the proposed multi-teacher
student model. This comparison allows us to quantify the impact of
joint training and to evaluate whether a unified encoder can preserve
attribute-specific information while sharing most of its parameters
across tasks.
blocks.zh:
对于每个属性,我们比较三类表述:
相应的冷冻教师模式,培训的单一任务学生模式
仅针对考虑过的属性和拟议的多教师
学生模式. 通过这一比较,我们可以量化:
联合培训,评估统一的编码器能否保留
属性特定信息,同时分享其大部分参数
跨任务。

blocks.en: IV-E 1 Multilingual speech retrieval
blocks.zh: IV-E 1 多语种语音检索

blocks.en:
We assess the semantic branch on multilingual speech retrieval.
For each experiment, we define a query set and a search set.
The query set contains speech utterances, while the search set contains the corresponding translated
items in another language.
The objective is to retrieve the correct translation of each query from all candidates in the search set.
Each query utterance is encoded into an utterance-level embedding using the semantic branch of the evaluated model.
When the search set contains speech, candidate utterances are encoded with the same speech encoder.
When the search set contains text, target sentences are encoded with BGE-M3.
Embeddings are normalized before retrieval, and candidates are ranked according to cosine similarity. Performance is reported with Recall@1.
In this work, we restrict the semantic evaluation to VoxPopuli and FLEURS.
VoxPopuli is used to evaluate multilingual speech retrieval on European languages, while FLEURS is used to assess generalization to a broader multilingual setting, including unseen and low-resource languages.
We compare the semantic branch of the proposed multi-teacher model with the semantic-only student and the SENSE teacher.
blocks.zh:
我们评估关于多语种语音检索的语义分支。
对于每个实验,我们定义一个查询集和一个搜索集.

当搜索集包含文本时,目标句子被编码为BGE-M3.

在这部作品中,我们将语义评价限制在VoxPopuli和FLEURS.
VoxPopuli用于评价欧洲语言的多语种语音检索,而FLEURS则用于评估泛化到更广泛的多语种环境,包括无形和低资源语言.
我们比较了拟议的多教师模式的语义分支与唯语义学生和SENSE教师.

blocks.en: IV-E 2 Speaker verification
blocks.zh: 议长核查

blocks.en:
We evaluate the quality of speaker-related information using the VoxCeleb1-O speaker verification protocol [ 47 ] .
Speaker embeddings are extracted from enrolment and test utterances using the speaker branch of the evaluated student models, or directly using the ECAPA-TDNN speaker teacher.
For each trial pair, verification scores are computed using cosine similarity between the two utterance-level speaker embeddings.
We compare the proposed multi-teacher model with the frozen ECAPA-TDNN speaker teacher and with a single-task speaker student trained using the same architecture but retaining only the speaker branch.
Performance
is reported in terms of Equal Error Rate (EER) and minimum normalized Detection Cost Function (minDCF), with P target = 0.01 P_{\mathrm{target}}=0.01 and C FA = C Miss = 1 C_{\mathrm{FA}}=C_{\mathrm{Miss}}=1 .

我们利用VoxCeleb1-O的发言者核查协议评价与发言者有关的信息的质量[47]。
演讲者嵌入语是从入学和测试语句中提取的,使用被评价学生模式的演讲者分支,或直接使用ECAPA-TDNN演讲者教师.
对每一对试验的核查分数均采用两种语音层扬声器嵌入式的余弦相似度计算。

blocks.en: IV-E 3 Language identification
blocks.zh: 语文识别

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether the language branch captures language-discriminative
information, we perform a language identification experiment on
VoxLingua107. For each model, we first extract utterance-level language
embeddings using the corresponding language representation: the frozen
language teacher, the single-task language student, or the language
branch of the multi-teacher student.
A lightweight classifier is trained on top of the extracted embeddings
using the VoxLingua107 training set and evaluated on its development
set. The embedding extractor remains frozen
during this classifier training stage. This protocol measures the
quality of the learned language embedding space independently of the
multi-teacher training objective.
Performance is reported in terms of classification error rate. A lower
error rate indicates that the extracted embeddings contain more
language-discriminative information.

blocks.en: IV-E 4 Speech emotion recognition
blocks.zh: IV-E 4 语音情感识别

blocks.en:
We evaluate the emotion branch on speech emotion recognition datasets.
For each emotion dataset, we extract utterance-level emotion embeddings
from the train, validation, and test partitions using three
representations: the frozen emotion teacher, the single-task emotion
student, and the emotion branch of the multi-teacher student.
For each dataset and each representation type, we train a separate
emotion classifier on the training partition of that dataset. The
validation partition is used for model selection, and the final
performance is reported on the test partition. This dataset-specific
evaluation protocol avoids mixing incompatible emotion taxonomies across
corpora and allows each classifier to match the number of emotion
classes defined for the corresponding dataset.
The embedding extractor remains frozen during classifier training. The classifier is therefore used only as a probing model to assess how much emotion-discriminative information is contained in the extracted representations. Performance is reported using unweighted accuracy (UA), which gives equal importance to each emotion class and is therefore suitable for evaluating emotion recognition performance under class imbalance.

我们评价情绪分支 在语音情感识别数据集。

blocks.en: IV-F Experimental results
blocks.zh: 四-F 实验结果

blocks.en:
In the table of results, we use the following notation. SENSE denotes the semantic teacher, ECAPA-spk denotes the speaker teacher, ECAPA-lang denotes the language teacher, and emotion2vec-base denotes the emotion teacher.
SEM-only, SPK-only, LANG-only, and EMO-only refer to single-task students trained with the same architecture as the proposed model but optimized with only one attribute-specific objective.
Multi-Attribute denotes our proposed model trained jointly with semantic, speaker, language, and emotion supervision.
blocks.zh:
在结果表中,我们使用下列标记。 SENSE表示语义老师,ECAPA-spk表示语义老师,ECAPA-lang表示语义老师,情感2vec-base表示语义老师.
SEM-Only,SPK-Only,LANG-Only,以及EMO-Only都是指接受过与拟议模型相同的架构训练,但仅以一个属性特定目标优化的单任务学生.
多属性表示我们提议的模式与语义学,演讲者,语言,情感监督共同训练.

blocks.en: IV-F 1 Semantic attribute
blocks.zh: IV-F 1 语义属性

blocks.en:
Tables II and III report Recall@1 scores for cross-lingual speech-to-speech retrieval on VoxPopuli and FLEURS corpora.
Overall, the Multi-Attribute model preserves semantic retrieval performance very well and often improves over the SEM-only student or the SENSE teacher.
These results indicate that Multi-Attribute supervision does not degrade the semantic space; on the contrary, the additional objectives can act as a regularizer and improve semantic retrieval robustness.

blocks.en: IV-F 2 Speaker verification
blocks.zh: 议长核查

blocks.en:
Table IV presents the speaker verification results on VoxCeleb1-O.
The ECAPA-spk teacher and the SPK-only student obtain the same EER of 0.899%.
The Multi-Attribute model obtains an EER of 0.915%, corresponding to a very small absolute increase of 0.016 points.
The minDCF values are also close across the three systems.
These results show that joint Multi-Attribute training introduces only a marginal cost for speaker verification, while allowing the same encoder to support several other utterance-level representations.
blocks.zh:

MINDCF值在三个系统中也接近.
这些结果显示,联合多属性培训只引入了语音验证的边际成本,同时允许同一编码器支持其他几个语音级别的表述.

blocks.en: IV-F 3 Language identification
blocks.zh: IV-F 3 语文识别

blocks.en:
Table V reports language identification performance.
The ECAPA-lang teacher obtains the lowest error rate, with 6.58%.
LANG-only remains close to the teacher, reaching 6.83%.
The Multi-Attribute model obtains 7.02% with its language attribute representation, corresponding to an absolute increase of only 0.19 points compared with LANG-only and 0.44 points compared with the teacher. Interestingly, by combining the language attribute with the semantic attribute generated by our model, we outperform the results reached by the ECAPA-lang teacher, showing that such a multi-attribute speech encoder provides complementary information useful to process some tasks.

blocks.en: IV-F 4 Speech emotion recognition

blocks.en:
We finally evaluate the emotion branch on speech emotion recognition (SER).
We compare three representations: the emotion2vec-base teacher, the EMO-only student, and the emotion branch of the Multi-Attribute model.
Figure 2 reports Unweighted Accuracy (UA) for each dataset.
The radar plot shows that in many datasets, Multi-Attribute matches or improves over both the EMO-only student and the emotion2vec-base teacher, indicating that the emotion branch benefits from the shared encoder rather than being systematically degraded by the additional objectives.

blocks.en:
Overall, the results across the four evaluation tasks show that the
proposed multi-teacher student can learn a unified speech encoder that
preserves multiple utterance-level attributes simultaneously. Compared
with single-task students, the Multi-Attribute model achieves competitive
performance on speaker verification, language identification, and speech
emotion recognition, while improving semantic retrieval on VoxPopuli and
remaining competitive on FLEURS. These findings support the central
hypothesis of this work: semantic, speaker, language, and emotion
representations can be distilled into a single shared speech encoder with
only limited trade-offs across attributes.

blocks.en: IV-G Layer-wise analysis
blocks.zh: 四-G 分层分析

blocks.en:
We are also interested by the changes due to the Multi-Attribute learning within the internal representations of the SSL backbone model.
We analyze the learned layer-interpolation weights α τ , ℓ \alpha_{\tau,\ell} associated with each attribute-specific branch.
These weights give an indication on how much each encoder layer contributes to the final utterance-level representation of a given attribute τ \tau .
blocks.zh:
我们也对在SSL主干模型的内部表述中进行多属性学习所带来的变化感兴趣。
我们分析与每个属性特定分支有关的 学习的层间插重。
这些加权表示每个编码器层对特定属性\ tau的最终表达式贡献了多少。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows the layer weights learned by the Multi-Attribute model. The semantic branch mainly relies on intermediate layers, with the largest weights around layers 12-14.
This suggests that semantic information is primarily captured by contextual middle-level representations. In contrast, speaker and language information are not concentrated in a narrow set of layers.
Their weights are distributed across a broader part of the encoder, indicating that speaker- and language-related cues are distributed across several levels of the representation.
The emotion branch follows a different trend, with stronger contributions from early-to-middle layers.
This suggests that emotion-related information relies more on acoustic and prosodic cues, which are better
preserved before the final contextual layers.
blocks.zh:
图3显示多属性模型所学的层重. 语义分支主要依靠中间层,在12-14层周围的重量最大.
这表明语义信息主要通过上下文的中层表述来获取. 相比之下,演讲者和语言信息并不集中在狭义的一组层.
它们的权重分布在编码器更广泛的部分,表明演讲和语言相关提示分布在代表的多个级别.
情感分支遵循不同的趋势,早期到中层的贡献更大.
这说明与情感相关的信息更多地依赖于声学和流派提示,这更好.
保存在最后的背景层之前。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Layer-interpolation weights learned by the four branches of the Multi-Attribute model. Semantic information is mainly extracted from intermediate layers, while speaker and language information are distributed across several encoder layers.
blocks.zh: 图3:多属性模型四个分支所学的层内插重. 语义信息主要从中间层提取,而扬声器和语言信息则分布在多个编码器层.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Layer-interpolation weights learned by the single-task students. Compared with the Multi-Attribute model, these distributions show that joint training modifies the layer usage of each attribute branch.
blocks.zh: 费格。 4: 单任务学生学习的层-插座权重. 与多属性模型相比,这些分布显示联合训练会改变每个属性分支的层使用.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 compares the layer-weight distributions of the single-task students. The comparison shows that Multi-Attribute training changes the way information is encoded in the shared encoder.
For example, the SEM-only student assigns stronger weights to the last layers, whereas the semantic branch of the Multi-Attribute model shifts toward intermediate layers. Similarly, speaker and language information remain broadly distributed, but their layer usage is reorganized when the encoder is jointly optimized with the other objectives.
These observations indicate that the Multi-Attribute model does not simply replicate the single-task representations.
Instead, joint training redistributes attribute-specific information across the encoder layers.
This depth-wise reorganization helps the shared encoder accommodate semantic, speaker, language, and emotion information within a single model, while preserving competitive performance across the downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
图4比较了单任务学生的分层加权分布. 比较显示,多属性培训改变了共享编码器中信息编码的方式.
例如,只有SEM的学生为上层分配更强的权重,而多属性模型的语义分支则转向中间层. 同样,扬声器和语言信息仍然分布广泛,但当编码器与其他目标联合优化时,其层使用被重组.
这些观察表明,多属性模型并不只是复制单任务表示.
相反,联合培训将属性特定信息重新分配到编码层。
这种深度的重组有助于共享编码器在一个单一模式内容纳语义、演说者、语言和情感信息,同时保持下游任务的竞争性表现。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a holistic multi-teacher post-training framework that enables a single self-supervised speech encoder to learn multiple complementary utterance-level speech representations through knowledge distillation.
By jointly distilling semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations from four specialized teacher models, the proposed approach replaces several task-specific encoders with a single shared backbone while preserving competitive performance across four independent downstream evaluation tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个全面的多教师培训后框架,使一个自我监督的语音编码器能够通过知识提炼学习多种互补的语音层面的语音表述。
通过从四个专业教师模式中联合提炼语义、演讲者、语言和情感表述,拟议方法用一个单一的共享主干取代几个特定任务编码器,同时保持四个独立下游评价任务的竞争性表现。

blocks.en:
Despite the heterogeneous nature of the supervision signals and datasets, the proposed model consistently approaches the performance of dedicated single-task students, while even improving semantic retrieval and showing that semantic and language representations can provide complementary information for language identification.
Beyond the downstream results, the learned layer interpolation weights reveal that different speech attributes naturally emerge at different depths of the shared SSL encoder, providing new insights into the internal organization of speech foundation models.
blocks.zh:
尽管监督信号和数据集性质各异,但拟议的模型始终关注专职的单任务学生的表现,甚至改进语义检索,并表明语义和语言表述可为语言识别提供补充信息。
在下游结果之外,学习到的地层插值权重揭示出不同的语音属性自然在共享的SSL编码器的不同深度中出现,为语音基础模型的内部组织提供了新的见解.

blocks.en:
More broadly, this work suggests that post-training can transform generic SSL speech encoders into holistic representation models capable of supporting multiple speech understanding tasks without requiring dedicated backbones.
We believe that this direction opens a promising path toward universal speech foundation models producing rich, reusable utterance-level representations for a wide range of downstream applications.
blocks.zh:
更广泛地说,这项工作表明,培训后可以将通用的SSL语音编码器转换成能够支持多个语音理解任务而不需要专用骨干的整体代表模型.
我们认为,这一方向开辟了通向通用语音基础模型的充满希望的道路,为各种下游应用提供了丰富的、可重复使用的言论层面的表述。
